input.prompt: One continuous 5 second shot, vertical 9:16, no cuts. @Image1 is the character sheet for the king: keep him exactly like it. @Video1 is the rough 3D previz of this shot: copy its camera move, framing, timing, cast and every character's position and action exactly, but render it in the painted style of @Image1, not the flat previz look.
